# Vendored schema — do not edit here

`fleekdash-manifest.schema.json` is copied from the FleekDash monorepo:

`fleekdash/fleekdash` → `packages/extension-contracts/schema/fleekdash-manifest.schema.json`

The runtime source of truth is `includes/Extension/ExtensionManifest.php`
in the monorepo. When the validator changes, update the contracts package
and re-vendor this file in the same change.
